notes.title: Trenches IS FINALLY COMING TO VR + Game Update V2.6.1- 12/07/25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40841703/bb19dd725310295fa20f90403a0a58397bc8d16c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey everyone!
[/b]
Hope you're all doing great.. it's been a while! First off, I want to apologize for the silence. Things have been a bit hectic lately as I've been hard at work on a couple of new game projects. But I come bearing some exciting news!
[/p][p][b]Let’s talk about [i]Trenches[/i].
[/b]
This was the very first game I ever created .. basically the project that kicked off my journey. It holds a special place in my heart, like a first child (haha). I know it wasn't perfect, and I completely understand that it wasn’t everyone’s cup of tea. But every bit of feedback along the way has been a chance to learn and grow — and I’m committed to always improving.[/p][p]Back on [b]July 20th, 2021[/b], someone asked if [i]Trenches[/i] would ever come to VR. At the time, I had no clue how VR even worked. But these last couple of years, I dove deeper into the world of virtual reality (while also working on my main projects) learning, experimenting, and building — all in hopes of making [i]DAN-di-WARhol[/i]’s dream a reality.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40841703/8589f6422bcfd8f0d084879ccce09a1c8e7cc1cd.png"][/img][/p][p]And yesterday, I finally announced [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687660/Trenches_VR/"]Trenches VR[/url] whic his being published by Prep Games and coming to [b]PCVR[/b] and other major platforms! This is my [b]first-ever VR title[/b], and I’m beyond excited. You can check out the official trailer below!
[/p][previewyoutube="9Cu2GDDrViM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
I’m fully committed to delivering hopefully a great horror VR experience. As always, your feedback really really helps a lot. In fact, after yesterday’s trailer dropped, I received a ton of suggestions - and instead of kicking back this Saturday, I dove right back into development to address some of that feedback. Here’s a little sneak peek of the improvements in the works!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40841703/3ccd3928de6e6023333df15c3f9b6650baa2796d.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40841703/396a58be1072799cfe93dd3ac72796af28c5d88d.png"][/img][/p][p]Also – good news for fans of the original Trenches as I’ve rolled out some updates for it too! These include:[/p][list][*][p]FPS lock and sync options.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to a few jumpscares.[/p][/*][*][p]Monster behavior tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]New sounds and audio.[/p][/*][*][p]General bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all so much for sticking with me on this journey I truly appreciate each and every one of you.[/p][p]
Feel free to join our community on Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK"]https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK[/url][/p][p]
Or follow me on Twitter for more updates: [url="https://x.com/@steelkrill"]https://x.com/@steelkrill[/url][/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget — you can [b]wishlist [i]TRENCHES VR[/i][/b] now below! Thanks again and have a great weekend! :)

notes.title: 'Trenches' Game Update V2.6.0 - 12/03/24
notes.content:
Hello! How is everyone doing? Been a while!

This is a small update because we had reports about some bugs, and also done some additional improvements. 

Game Patch: V2.6.0 is live!

I would like to thank you as always for your support, suggestions and feedback along the development of Trenches. I really appreciate your support, as a solo developer this really means so much to me as always. I try to always do my best in updating the games!

- Fixed an issue where the player falls off in the hiding zone.
- Changed some collider issues in the map, making some other hiding zones falling outside the map.
- Fix an issue with the monster where sometimes he is not able to get your microphone input.
- Updated some sounds and animations for the jumpscares.
- Updated some randomized jumpscares in the game to be less frequently.
- Objectives is more outlined to show you where it is, especially if within a certain radius. 
- Increased the texture sizes of walls, floors and other props to make it look a bit better.
- Fixed some other minor bug issues.
- 'No Jumpscare mode' have also been updated with these changes.

Hopefully, we have some BIG NEWS related to Trenches soon which I can't share for the moment, and I am currently working hard to try and get it out as soon as possible - so Trenches fans please stay tuned! :)

Feel free to join us on our tiny but loving community on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK


Thank you again for your support and hope you all have a fantastic day.

notes.title: 'Trenches' Game Update V.1.2.5 - 29/11/21 (Enemy can now hear you!)
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I hope you are all doing great.

Had a very crazy month. I was sick again and things felt strange, I went to do the test and I was positive with COVID. Had to move all my things to somewhere else and had to stay in quarantine. I was not doing too great, since I also suffer from Asthma - but that did not stop me from getting an update for Trenches! (I am doing alright now! Last few days in quarantine and things should hopefully be back to normal) ːsteammockingː

I was working on a new feature for Trenches and here is. Please note this is still early, so the feature may not work as intended. Hopefully, I will update it for the better as time goes on with all your suggestions and help.

Game Patch: V1.2.5 is now live!

As always once again - I would like to thank you all for your support, suggestions and feedback.

So, what is new in the latest update? [b]The enemy can now hear you talk and breath through your microphone.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lWF1sJS.png[/img]

The new update includes a new feature which twitch streamers may not like very much, which is [b]Microphone Input[/b]. The enemy can now hear you if you have a microphone. It can hear you talk, scream and breath. This means that if you have a mic and you make a sound when close to the enemy, then he can hear you and come running towards where you are.

Now you need to control where you step, move, blow your whistle - and also your breathing too. 

[i]If the monster is near and you are in a hiding spot then he won't go away until you stop breathing. That means you have to stop making any noise necessary, otherwise you will be dead. [/i] The enemy can only hear the sounds you make only if he is close enough and depending on how much you scream. The whistle will always be much louder and be heard at a much further distance. 

A new rule have been added: "[i]Enemies can hear your breath, if you hear that they are near - control your breathing.".[/i]

I also did add the option to turn Microphone Input Off for players that don't want the enemy to hear their voice - it will be turned on automatically so if you wish to turn it off then you can in the settings too. ːsteamhappyː

With that being said - I also updated the weapon in the game, while it still won't hurt the enemy - it will slow it down a bit if you take multiple shots at it, giving you a chance to make your escape (especially if you are out of breath). I also worked on the optimization and the textures a bit. I also added some new settings, UIs, models, textures, deleted some unused files etc.

There is also a new UI ear icon now that shows on the screen and this means that the enemy can hear you at any given time, but if you use the whistle / or talk then the risks are higher. If red lines start appearing on the ear, that means that you are making too much noise.

However, please note the only way you WILL know if an enemy knows or suspects where you are is by hearing the sound of his footsteps. Is he running or walking? Walking means he is searching for you, but RUNNING means he suspects or heard something .. so that means if he RUNNING, then you SHOULD BE TOO.

[b]The enemy will now hear your voice in real-time. As you can see, when you speak some red lines will appear on the ear icon, this means you are making too much noise. This will appear if you speak loud a lot or if you blow your whistle.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NtR6kTC.gif[/img]

[b]You have to also control your breathing in order for the enemy to go away.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jvjr2qE.gif[/img]

Let me know what you think of this! I am more then happy to listen to all your suggestions to improve. Please note that this is still very early, so it will be improved upon on hopefully.

[list]
[*] Microphone Input was now added in the game. The enemy can now hear your voice in real-time.
[*] If you are near the enemy and you breath heavily, then you can give away your position.
[*] The sound and footsteps of the enemy have been improved, since now they play larger part of it.
[*] An On/Off button in the settings have been added so you can switch off Microphone Input at any given time, this way the enemy will not hear your voice then.
[*] Since things are now a bit harder, I also updated the outline for the clue to be more visible.
[*] The gun now slows the enemy down instead of doing nothing, this will give you more time to escape too if you shoot him multiple times.
[*] New UI have been added which shows you if you are making a lot of noise or not. This is mostly used if you are talking a lot on your microphone or if you use the whistle.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs and done some minor changes to the map layout.
[*] Some minor changes to the UI and graphics have been made.
[*] Some minor changes to the enemy have been made.
[*] New additional sound effects were added.
[*] Some triggers for jump-scares were changed in the game too.
[*] More optimization have been made for the game.
[*] Textures and materials have been updated, the ground texture have also been improved.
[*] Reduced the game file size again and deleted unnecessary files that were taking space. 
[*] Some more performance changes have been made.
[*] Some text have been changed and updated.
[*] You can turn off the "Pinkish" effect in the game in the settings menu at the Main Menu before you start the game. This will remove the effect for your game.
[*] All updates apply to both the normal game mode and the no jumpscare game mode.
[/list]

I wish to once again take the time to thank you all for the support and suggestions. You are all amazing. Feel extra free to submit any feedback, criticism or suggestions for the game. If you like, you can also share it as this will also help out a ton to get into more eyes ːsteammockingː.. Without you, there would not have been these updates, I am very grateful - so thank you. 

Thanks again guys, good day all and stay safe!

notes.title: 'Trenches' Game Update V.1.2.4 - 28/10/21
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I hope you are all doing great.

First of all; Happy Halloween! I hope you get as much candy as possible! ːsteamhappyː

Game Patch: V1.2.4 is now live!

As always - I would like to thank you all for your support, suggestions and feedback.

This is a minor update unfortunately, I was very sick these past few weeks so I could not work much on the game. I am back again on my feet slowly, so I decided to work on something minor to keep up the pace.

Once again I was working mostly on the optimization and removing some unused files. I also added some new signs, few more decals and added a bit more details such as a simple footprints system which can be seen in the GIF below, and some others.

"Simple Footprints system have been made. If the player is stepping on the mud, and move on the wood then he will make a muddy footprint on it. This will mark the location where the player have been which can give you some time to know which way you came from in the Trenches (if you are lost), however within time - the rain will fade away the muddy foot prints."

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fRqRHgt.gif[/img]

This was something simple but was always on my mind - which will be improved upon hopefully.

[list]
[*] Once again I updated the outline for the clue to be more visible. This means, each time the player uses the Trench Whistle to find the clue then it will highlight from a much more distance, as this was suggested too.
[*] Footprints system have been made. If the player is stepping on the mud, and move on the wood then he will make a muddy footprint on it. This will mark the location where the player have been which can give you some time to know which way you came from in the Trenches (if you are lost), however within time - the rain will fade away the muddy foot prints.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs and done some minor changes to the map layout.
[*] Updated the enemy speed to be more suitable for the game.
[*] The difficulty of the game has been decreased. You are now also more likely to find the clues, as they will highlight from a further distance.
[*] New additional sound effects were added.
[*] Some triggers for jump-scares were changed in the game and some were completely removed.
[*] More optimization have been made for the game.
[*] Some textures and materials have been updated.
[*] Reduced the game file size once again!
[*] Some more performance changes have been made.
[*] Added new models, papers and decals around the Trenches.
[*] The sounds for the clues that plays when you use the Trench Whistle, have been improved and can now be heard from a further distance too.
[*] All updates apply to both the normal game mode and the no jumpscare game mode.
[/list]

Will you be playing this Halloween with the lights out? Let me know! I love to hear you out.

Also I wish to remind everyone that there is always the option to try the game out with less (at least) jumpscares if wish with the 'No Jumpscare Mode', so make use for that too if you are not a fan of jumpscares! ːsteamhappyː

I wish to once again take the time to thank you all for the support. Feel more then free to submit any feedback, criticism or suggestions for the game. If you like, you can also share it as this will also help out a ton to get into more eyes ːsteammockingː.. I LOVE hearing all feedback as this helps me improve. Thanks again, good day all and stay safe!

notes.title: 'Trenches' Game Update V.1.1.6 (Weapons, New Mode, Enemy & More) - 10/08/21
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I hope you are all doing well.

It's been a very busy week - but finally the update is here! ːsteamhappyː

[b]Game Patch: V.1.1.6 is now live![/b]

As always - I would like to thank you all for your support, suggestions and feedback. Some of the updates were all suggested by you, so thank you so much and keep them coming! I will be more then happy to hear all your suggestions and feedbacks as this helps me to improve 'Trenches'.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/aHIaE6i.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/aHIaE6i.png[/img][/url]

'Trenches' has gotten a new bigger update and one of them is the new weapon system and a new game mode. This is something that was requested a lot, especially regarding the jumpscares of the game. Some of them have been changed or toned down in the normal mode, and while I can work on that - I also added a new mode which is called 'No Jumpscare Mode'. Even though it says 'No Jumpscare Mode' - in reality there are still some, but most of them are gone especially the randomized ones. 

Apart from that - the enemy also got a new touch. I hope you like the new one! ːsteamhappyː

You can watch the NEW trailer with the weapon and enemy in action here:

[previewyoutube=dOwnGrFBxlw;full][/previewyoutube]

Major Updates:

* Weapons are now added in the game. You can find a weapon in the Trenches which can make you feel a bit more safer. Weapons will be stored in the Inventory and can be equipped at any time you want. The weapon will also limit you to do certain things.

* New 'game mode' have been added. A new game mode was added which is called 'No Jumpscare Mode' and this decreases the amount of jumpscares in the game. A lot of feedback went into the jumpscares so I decided to add this mode for now till I can slowly work on the other jumpscares. Please note that some jumpscares are still in the game, however mostly are the scripted ones - all the randomized scares are little-to-none. Some loud jumpscares were completely removed.

* New updated, modified enemy with updated animations. The enemy now have been worked on a lot and looks a bit more alive and feels more threatening. A lot of people asked what the enemy will do when he find you and how is he going to attack you - this will now find a solution to that question.
[/list]

Apart from that there are some other changes in the game.

[list]
[*] Enemy was reworked on and got a new look and it's been modified to look a bit more alive.
[*] Fixed the game winning screen to take more time in order to read the text.
[*] Updated the game ending screen that fits with the new enemy.
[*] Enemy also now have a new set of animations.
[*] Enemy now also includes more sounds for taunting the player.
[*] Updated the navigation of the enemy.
[*] New animations have been made.
[*] Weapons have now been added in the game. [i]Please note this is still a major update and in WIP.[/i]
[*] Added guns which the player can use with animations. Player can now find and store guns in the inventory. 
[*] Weapons can be equipped by [1] or any shortcuts of your choice. You can change the shortcut in the Inventory screen.
[*] New game-mode called 'No Jumpscare Mode' is now available. You can choose to start a normal game or a No Jumpscare Mode game. No Jumpscare Mode have little-to-no jumpscares instead.
[*] Updated Main Menu - you can now select if you wish to start a normal game, or a No Jumpscare Mode game.
[*] Updated some trigger events in the Trenches.
[*] Updated sounds effects.
[*] Some jumpscares were changed and updated.
[*] Added the option which you can turn 'Smooth Look' on or off in the settings menu. (In-Game Only)
[*] Camera effects settings have been updated.
[*] Updated some notes and pictures around the map.
[*] New sound effects have been made.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs and issues.
[*] Some grammer typo have been fixed. 
[/list]

Do let me know what you think of the new update! Thank you again for your support. Keep the feedbacks and suggestions coming! Good day.

notes.title: 'Trenches' Game Update V.1.1.3 - 26/07/21
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I hope you are all doing great.

Game Patch: V.1.1.3 is now live! 

As always - I would like to thank you all for your support, suggestions and feedback. 

I wish to also take the time to thank you all so much for your support. This really means so much to me! It was my dream to get my horror game out there and I am trying to do my best in continuing that dream with all your help ːsteamhappyː .. so thank you so much! [b]You're all amazing.[/b]

As I said on my post about my [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1681510/discussions/0/3053988173721510458/]planned features[/url] here - I wanted that the inventory system to play a bigger part in the game. Therefore, I am adding items that can be collected in the Inventory. In the previous [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1681510/eventcomments/3053988173724325018?snr=1_5_9_]update [/url]the map was made to be a collectable instead so you can use it from the Inventory. Now the Wire Cutter has been added to the game along with barb wire to block paths and some other changes.

[list]
[*] Updated the new map system with more signs and some fixes.
[*] Wire cutters have been added into the game. You can now find the wire cutters and you can then cut down barb wire that it's on your way.
[*] Barb wire now appears in the map which will block your way unless you have a wire cutter.
[*] Fixed a glitch where a white box was appearing sometimes in the map.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Settings where being disabled/enabled randomly on the start of the game.
[*] Camera effects settings have been updated.
[*] Updated the enemies navigation.
[*] Some map layouts have been changed.
[*] Enemy now includes more sounds for taunting the player.
[*] Enemy is now more deadlier, with an increased eye-sight and speed.
[*] Enemy's footsteps sounds have been decreased.
[*] The player can now no longer prone, but only crouch instead.
[*] Updated some trigger events.
[*] Key bindings have been updated. You can change the keys to anything you like from the Main Menu by going in Controls.
[*] Notes, pictures and letters have been scattered around the map. Some letters also tell some stories.
[*] More life have been added to the Trenches - insects, ants and other type of critters.
[*] New sound effects have been made.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs and issues.
[/list]

The new added update now contains the [b]wire cutter [/b], which will be placed around the map for you to find. Once found, you can put it in your inventory and any Barb Wire* that you come across the map then you can cut it off. If not, then you can not access that area and you need to take a longer path or have to find another way across.

[b]Here is the Wire Cutter in action.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uvoDS61.gif[/img]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/uvoDS61.gifv]Click here if you can't see the GIF.[/url]

The new map system have have been updated once again, along with some other new features. 

[b]Here is the map system in action.
[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2pJbUEk.gif[/img]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/2pJbUEk.gifv]Click here if you can't see the GIF.[/url]

Also the settings on the last updated were glitched, some of them were showing disabled while the effects were indeed enabled. This has also been fixed. The post-processing effects can now be disabled in the main menu, while the other effects (such as camera blinking, rain drops effects and such) can only be disabled/enabled once you started a new game (in the in-game menu) for the moment.

Thank you again for your support. Keep the feedbacks and suggestions coming! Good day.

notes.title: 'Trenches' Game Update V.1.1.2 - 22/07/21

Hello everybody!

[*] Added a new option in the settings where you can now disable or enable anti-analising effect.
[*] Added a new option in the settings where you can now disable or enable Ambient Occlusion effect.
[*] Updated the enemies navigation.
[*] Fixes minor bugs and issues.
[/list]

Thank you again for your support. Keep the feedbacks and suggestions coming! Good day.
